```
import smoothscroll from "smoothscroll-polyfill";
import { DEFAULT_LANGUAGE } from "@/config/language";
import { IInternational } from "@/types";
import { getLanguage } from "./language";
import dicomParser from "dicom-parser";

// 防止手机、平板设备不支持smooth平滑滚动效果
smoothscroll.polyfill();

/**
 * 获取服务器返回的错误信息
 * @param error 错误信息对象
 * @param serverDisconnected 服务器断开连接错误信息
 * @returns 返回文本格式的错误信息
 */
export const getErrorMessage = (error: any, serverDisconnected: string) => {
	const errorInfo = error?.response?.body?.message;
	if (errorInfo) {
		if (typeof errorInfo === "string") {
			if (errorInfo.toLowerCase().includes("request has been terminated")) {
				return serverDisconnected;
			} else {
				return errorInfo;
			}
		} else {
			return errorInfo.message[(getLanguage() || DEFAULT_LANGUAGE) as keyof IInternational];
		}
	} else if (error?.response?.text && typeof error?.response?.text === "string") {
		return JSON.parse(error.response.text).message.message[(getLanguage() || DEFAULT_LANGUAGE) as keyof IInternational];
	} else if (error.message) {
		if (typeof error.message === "string") {
			if (error.message.toLowerCase().includes("request has been terminated")) {
				return serverDisconnected;
			} else {
				return error.message;
			}
		} else {
			if (error.message) {
				return error.message?.[(getLanguage() || DEFAULT_LANGUAGE) as keyof IInternational];
			} else {
				return serverDisconnected;
			}
		}
	} else {
		return serverDisconnected;
	}
};

/**
 * 把20200904这种格式的时间转换为2020年09月04日
 * @param dateStr 字符串日期
 * @returns 格式后的日期格式
 */
export const formatDateString = (dateStr: string) => {
	if (!dateStr) {
		return "";
	}
	const year = dateStr.substring(0, 4);
	const month = dateStr.substring(4, 6);
	const day = dateStr.substring(6, 8);

	// 使用Date对象验证日期（可选）
	const date = new Date(`${year}-${month}-${day}`);
	if (isNaN(date.getTime())) {
		return dateStr;
	}
	return `${year}年${month}月${day}日`;
};

/**
 * 获取文件名称的名称和后缀
 * @param fileName 文件名称
 * @returns 名称和后缀
 */
export const getFilenameInfo = (fileName: string | null | undefined) => {
	if (!fileName) {
		return {
			name: "",
			ext: null,
		};
	}
	const fileNameArr = fileName.split(".");
	if (fileNameArr.length > 1) {
		let ext = fileNameArr.pop() || "";
		return {
			name: fileNameArr.join("."),
			ext: ext,
		};
	} else {
		return {
			name: fileName,
			ext: null,
		};
	}
};

/**
 * 把文件大小转换成带单位的字符串
 * @param kSize 文件大小
 * @param unit 单位
 * @returns 带单位的字符串
 */
export const getUploadAssetSize = (kSize: number, unit: string) => {
	if (unit.toLowerCase() === "kb") {
		return `${kSize / 1024}KB`;
	}
	if (unit.toLowerCase() === "mb") {
		return `${kSize / 1024 / 1024}MB`;
	}
	if (unit.toLowerCase() === "gb") {
		return `${kSize / 1024 / 1024 / 1024}GB`;
	}
	return `${kSize}B`;
};

/**
 * 把#123#格式的字符串id转换为数字类型的数组
 * @param idStr #123#格式的字符串id
 * @returns 数字类型的数组
 */
export const idStrToNumArr = (idStr: string | null | undefined) => {
	if (idStr) {
		return idStr.split(",").map((roleStr: string) => Number(roleStr.replaceAll("#", "")));
	}
	return [];
};

/**
 * 把数字类型的id数组转换为#123#,#456#格式的字符串
 * @param ids 数字类型的id数组
 * @returns #123#,#456#格式的字符串
 */
export const idNumArrToIdStr = (ids: number[]) => {
	return ids.map(id => `#${id}#`).join(",");
};

/**
 * 平滑的滚动到页面顶部
 * @param element 默认是window，可以传递需要滚动的对象元素
 */
export const smoothScrollToTop = (element: any = window) => {
	element.scrollTo({
		top: 0,
		left: 0,
		behavior: "smooth",
	});
};

/**
 *
 * @param email 邮箱地址
 * @returns 邮箱地址是否验证通过
 */
export const validateEmail = (email: string) => {
	// 所有邮箱验证正则
	const reg = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
	// const reg = /^[1-9]\d{4,10}@qq\.com$/;
	if (!reg.test(email)) {
		return false;
	}
	return true;
};

/**
 * 验证当前对象是否有权限使用
 * @param requiredPermissions 当前需要的角色权限
 * @param currentUserPermissions 当前用户的角色权限
 * @returns 是否有权限
 */
export const checkPermission = (requiredPermissions: string[], currentUserPermissions: string[]) => {
	if (requiredPermissions.length <= 0) {
		return true;
	} else {
		const roles = currentUserPermissions.filter(role => requiredPermissions.includes(role));
		return roles.length > 0;
	}
};

// 解析文件里的 SeriesInstanceUID
export async function getSeriesUID(file: File): Promise<string> {
	return new Promise(resolve => {
		const reader = new FileReader();
		reader.onload = function () {
			let arrayBuffer: ArrayBuffer | null = reader.result as ArrayBuffer;
			let dataSet: any = null;
			try {
				dataSet = dicomParser.parseDicom(new Uint8Array(arrayBuffer));
				const seriesUID = dataSet.string("x0020000e"); // SeriesInstanceUID
				resolve(seriesUID || "UNKNOWN_SERIES");
			} catch (error) {
				throw new Error("dcm文件解析失败," + error);
			} finally {
				// 手动释放引用，提示 GC
				dataSet = null;
				arrayBuffer = null;
			}
		};
		reader.onerror = function (err) {
			console.warn("FileReader 读取失败，返回 UNKNOWN_SERIES", err);
			resolve("UNKNOWN_SERIES");
		};
		reader.readAsArrayBuffer(file);
	});
}
```

### config/webpack/persistentCache/createEnvironmentHash.js
```
'use strict';
const { createHash } = require('crypto');

module.exports = env => {
  const hash = createHash('md5');
  hash.update(JSON.stringify(env));

  return hash.digest('hex');
};
```
